component.name: Signpost
component.summary: Find what a Windows name is called on KDE

description.p: Signpost is for the week after the switch. The install went fine, the files came across, the welcome tour has been dismissed — and now every third thing you want to do begins with not knowing what it is called.
Type the word you already know — Task Manager, Control Panel, Win+E — and Signpost tells you what it is here, what the shortcut is on this machine, and opens it for you.
It answers from your own system rather than from a wiki page:

ul.li: Shortcuts are read from the running configuration, so if you have rebound one, that is what you are told.
An answer whose application is not installed says so, and offers to install it, rather than pretending.
Where there is genuinely no equivalent — the registry, product keys, OneDrive — it says that plainly instead of inventing one.

description.p: Answers also appear in KRunner, so pressing Meta and typing the Windows word is enough.
